title: kz-coherent-sheaf
description: A sheaf on the bitopological settling site that satisfies the KZ-coherence descent condition - it assigns identical section maps to any two parallel 1-cells connected by an invertible 2-cell arising from the KZ-lax-idempotent coherence of the temporal 2-category. The object generated by imposing this 2-cell descent condition on a sheaf.

kzCoherence.description: for every pair of parallel 1-cells f, f' connected by an invertible KZ 2-cell alpha : f => f', the induced section maps agree: F(f) = F(f')
